C1620.title: Hangzhou Internet Court Hears AI Face-Swap App Infringement of Portrait Rights Case
C1620.summary: In late 2022, the Hangzhou Internet Court heard a case in which a Shanghai-based company operated an 'AI face-swap' app that used deep synthesis technology to create forged videos of plaintiff Lou without consent. The court ruled the act infringed the plaintiff's portrait rights and ordered the app developer to apologize and pay compensation totaling 5,000 yuan.

references.title: Deceived by AI Beauties on Social Platforms? This is How Deep Synthesis Technology Should Be Governed
